title: 冬休みのこどもたち
subject_en: Winter-holiday children scenes with ONE cheerful child (round head, dot eyes, rosy cheeks, simple winter clothes), each a small complete scene with a few props, crayon hand-drawn style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: 冬休みの宿題、大そうじ、雪あそび、お年玉。冬休みのこどもの1日12場面。終業式のおたよりやしおりに。
items: a child doing homework at a low desk with a pencil and a workbook
a child writing a daily schedule chart on a big sheet
a child wiping a window with a cloth and a bucket
a child rolling a large snowball next to a small snowman
a child sliding downhill on a sled with a scarf flying
a child in a kotatsu table peeling a tangerine
a child receiving a small decorated envelope with both hands
a child writing with a big brush on long paper, no readable letters
a child running with a kite flying up
two children playing a card game on the floor
a child with a small mallet next to a mortar of mochi and a helper hand
a child under a blanket with a sleepy face and a clock
